author: Shenandoah Valley News
title: Arlington County Board schedules public hearing on proposed capital improvement plan for July 7
text:
Arlington County Board schedules public hearing on proposed capital improvement plan for July 7
Arlington County will hold a public hearing on its proposed Fiscal Years 2027-2039 Capital Improvement Plan (CIP) on July 7 at 6:30 PM at 2100 Clarendon Boulevard, Suite 307.
The County Board announced that online speaker registration will open at 8:00 AM five business days before the hearing. Residents can register to speak by visiting the County Board website, calling 703-228-3130 during business hours, or signing up in person on the day of the meeting. The deadline to register is July 7 at 6:30 PM. The public is invited to attend the session in person or watch via live stream on the County's website and on local cable stations Comcast 25 & 1073 and Verizon FiOS 39 & 40.
"NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN THAT THE COUNTY BOARD OF ARLINGTON CO., VA, on Tuesday, July 7, 2026, at 6:30 PM or as soon thereafter as matters may be heard, at 2100 Clarendon Boulevard, Suite 307, Arlington, VA 22201, will hold a public hearing on Arlington’s Fiscal Years 2027 - 2039 Proposed Capital Improvement Plan (CIP). Online speaker registration will open at 8:00 AM five business days in advance of the hearing. To register, visit the County Board website, call 703-228-3130 Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM, or sign up in-person the day of the meeting. The deadline to register to speak is Tuesday, July 7, 2026, at 6:30 PM. The public is welcome to attend the work session in person or view via live stream on the County's website and on local cable stations Comcast 25 & 1073 and Verizon FiOS 39 & 40. To submit a written comment on the Proposed CIP, email the County Board at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection). All comments will be made part of the public record for the Proposed CIP and will be considered by the County Board during its deliberations. The Board will adopt the FY 2027 - 2039 CIP at its July 2026 County Board Meetings. Visit the County’s website for more information on the FY 2027-2039 Proposed Capital Improvement Plan, including video and presentations from County Board work sessions with departments and the County Manager’s presentation to the Board. For questions on the work session, contact the Clerk to the County Board at 703-228-3130 or [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)," according to Mason Kushnir, Clerk to the County Board.
The Capital Improvement Plan outlines Arlington’s long-term investments in infrastructure, facilities, and other major projects. The County Board will consider public comments submitted by email as part of its deliberations before adopting the plan at its July meetings. More information, including presentations and videos from previous work sessions, is available on the County’s website.
For further questions about the work session, residents are encouraged to contact the Clerk to the County Board. The County encourages public participation in the process and will make all comments part of the official record.
